title: op: shell stdout capture for gate consumption
wanted_capability: Workflow gate predicates must be able to consume stdout/exit from `op: shell` steps (analogous to `capture` for command steps in refactor-run).
notes: H3's nightly-eval-arc and several others ship as observable skeletons because gate predicates can only see workflow vars + node prompt output, not subprocess stdout. When this lands, gate routing on actual results becomes possible.
resolution_note: Implemented (verified 2026-07-14 on beta/blackbox-v2): exec_shell (src/workflow/ops/external.rs) writes {exit_code, stdout, stderr, parsed} into vars[into_var]; gate packets consume it from the flattened ArcContext (vars.<var>.exit_code / .parsed.*). Covered by ops/tests.rs shell-capture tests (exit_code assertions at :754/:776/:818) and consumed in production by nightly-eval-arc: RunSuite shell → into_var suite_output → ScoreEvalOutput reads args.suite_output → Decide gates on domain:eval/drift-policy. The capability this gap asked for exists end-to-end.
